comment: wintty.c erase_menu_or_text() dismisses the full-screen options menu with docrt() and flush_screen(1) while select_menu() keeps bot() disabled. cls() blanks the status rows, and the flush then prints map row 20, which ^F mapped and which lies on the first of three status lines on a 24-row terminal; the corridor glyph there stays visible under the next menu ("Do what?" for autopickup exceptions). Variation: menu-dismissal-keeps-map-over-three-line-status-two-lines.
